rule: A supported snapshot producer is not an admitted attachment. Only the two pinned SORS pairs in src/lib/researchPackageRights.ts are admitted today; every other class below is reference-only in a research package.

classes.data_sources: src/data/observations/observations.json (current 2021–2025 'formal' layer) and the annual descriptive history (src/data/historical/annual_descriptive_history.json, raw extracts under src/data/historical/raw/annual/)
classes.observation_scope: one row per country-indicator-year; per-year source URL
classes.source_metadata_in_export: institution 'Eurostat'; dataset string combining Eurostat and a national portal (e.g. 'Eurostat prc_hicp_aind / Statistics Poland Data Portal'); per-year API URL; updated_at 2026-07-17; retrieved_at blank
classes.existing_provenance: canonical record updated_at only; the history layer's retained raw extracts carry query URL, retrieval time, HTTP status, dataset update time and SHA-256 (annual_history_manifest.json)
classes.version_information: Eurostat UPDATE_DATA per dataset (no edition numbers)
classes.redistribution_eligibility: none admitted (rights engine pins SORS only)
missing_evidence: registry row still 'documented' (now readable: see rights_assessments)
national co-source wording in the canonical label is unexplained
canonical retrieval for the 2021–2025 layer not retained
